analyst.summary: Edelweiss Financial Services is a diversified financial holding company with lending, wealth management, asset management and insurance businesses. Its overall revenue has been broadly flat to declining over the past five years as the group has deliberately simplified and de-risked its balance sheet following the funding-market stress of 2019. The most recent quarter showed both revenue and profit down versus a year ago. The business isn't showing signs of acute stress, but it also isn't showing the growth momentum that would justify a more constructive view right now.
